response.original_title: [FAQs-Add-Passenger] How do I add a Passenger to my Star of the sea Cruise
response.overview: To add a passenger to a Star of the Seas (Royal Caribbean) cruise +1-866-254-7549, you must call customer service directly +1-866-254-7549 or contact your Royal Caribbean Blog travel agent, as this cannot be done online or through the mobile app.How to Request the Addition Call Royal Caribbean: Dial +1-866-254-7549 (US) if you booked your trip directly with the cruise line. Contact your Travel Agent: Reach out to your third-party travel advisor +1-866-254-7549 or agency directly if you did not book direct.Requirements and Rules Capacity Limits: Your stateroom and the ship itself must have the physical and legal capacity for the extra guest +1-866-254-7549. You may need to upgrade your room if it is already at capacity. Details Needed: Be ready with your reservation number +1-866-254-7549, plus the new guest's full legal name and birthdate. Pricing: +1-866-254-7549 Adding a guest re-prices the booking using current prevailing rates for fares, taxes, and port fees.
